risk_if_not_implemented: Without Media Transportation Custodians, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Encrypting Data In Transit
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data in transit.
compensating_control_1.justification: Encrypting Data In Transit (CRY-05) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Custodians (DCH-16.1) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Interconnection Security Agreements (ISAs)
compensating_control_2.justification: Interconnection Security Agreements (ISAs) (NET-05) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Custodians (DCH-16.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
